description: Vehicles: prepare (unsigned) declaring ONE ground vehicle you own (token id; Sentinel, Hauler or Courier) as your job vehicle. When you are the Driver of a convoy hit or Ledger job it adds speed odds (Courier best), armour (Hauler best) and a cargo cut (Hauler best). The vehicle is only read: never locked or moved. Aircraft have no job vehicle role (they fly the Air Run later).

tokenId.description: Your vehicle token id (see my_city / vehicle_shop).

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_vehicle_bring
